title: Attack sequences
description: How strikes stack, per loadout (docs/core/combat.md#attacks-by-loadout, GD_S05_01): the attack action's AP and its strikes in order, each with its hand and attack modifier, the off-hand jab, and the strikes a full attack and a circle cut add. Perks change the strikes only through modifier targets (full_attack_strikes, full_attack_off_strikes, mainhand_penalty, offhand_penalty), so this table stays the one place that says how attacks stack.

min_extra_ap.description: A full attack spends every AP left, and needs at least the loadout's attack AP plus this.

extra_main_attacks.description: The attack value of each extra main-hand strike full_attack_strikes adds, in order; no more strikes than listed.

extra_off_attack.description: Added to the loadout's off-hand strike value for the extra off-hand strike full_attack_off_strikes adds (at most one).

one_handed_reload_extra.description: AP a reload costs over the reload action when the other hand holds anything (docs/core/combat.md#ranged-loadouts).

attack.description: The attack value of the one main-hand strike at each foe in reach.

ranged_hands.description: The hand kinds that hold a ranged weapon: a strike with one is a ranged strike (docs/core/combat.md#ranged-loadouts).

shield_bash.description: Boss Strike's shield bash (GD_S05_03): the shield as an off-hand weapon, by the attacker's boss_strike tier.

as_off.description: The off hand the shield counts as for the attack sequence row (its jab and strikes).

damage_type.description: The bash's damage type; the damage is the shield's DR plus the damage roll (1d4).

jab.description: The tier from which a jab is a bash.

attack.description: The tier from which the attack and the full attack also strike with the shield.

stagger.description: The tier from which a bash that hits costs the target stagger_ap.

after_block.description: The tier from which a bash right after a block costs after_block_ap.

stagger_ap.description: AP a bash that hits costs the target on its next turn.

after_block_ap.description: The bash's AP right after a block in the attacker's band.

attack.description: Added to the strike's attack target; mainhand_penalty or offhand_penalty softens a negative one, never past 0.

main.description: The main-hand loadouts this row covers.

off.description: The off-hand loadouts this row covers.

ap.description: The attack action's AP with this loadout.

strikes.description: The attack's strikes, in order; each is its own roll through the combat pipeline.

jab.description: One off-hand strike alone; only a loadout with an off-hand weapon has one.
